papers.title_en: Standardized Tolerance for Adaptive Reuse and Repair: A Method for HNSW Migration Under Embedding Model Change Scenarios
papers.authors: Hengzhao Ma, Chenyang Zhu, Bin Wang, Xiaochun Yang
papers.evidence: 在嵌入模型更换后迁移HNSW近邻图索引
papers.tldr: 嵌入模型更换后，同一对象集合被重编码，HNSW索引需适配新向量空间。STARR比较源邻居列表在两空间中的标准化边长，并用距离剖面相关性设定允许增幅，再在部分迁移图中搜索并共享候选以重连受影响顶点。三个百万级数据集上较Fresh构建加速5.25–44.54倍，15个迁移均快于DGM变体，Recall@10多数接近Fresh。其最终修复保证底层可达与度约束，为模型切换下的索引迁移提供高效方案。
papers.abstract_en: When an embedding model changes, the same collection is re-encoded, and its vector index must be adapted to the new embedding space. Because the source and target vectors represent the same objects, suitable connections in the source index can be reused. We propose STARR (Standardized Tolerance for Adaptive Reuse and Repair) to migrate HNSW indexes after an embedding model change. STARR compares standardized edge lengths over the same source neighbor lists in both embedding spaces and uses the correlation between their distance profiles to set the allowable increase in standardized edge length. It reconnects affected vertices by searching the partially migrated graph and shares the resulting candidates with their neighbors. We bound edge rejection under local distance distortion, characterize migration work, and prove that a final repair pass makes every vertex reachable from the entry point at the base layer while respecting degree limits. Single-threaded experiments on MS MARCO, Wikipedia, and CC3M, each with one million objects, show that STARR achieves 5.25--44.54$\times$ construction speedups over Fresh and migrates faster than both DGM variants on all 15 selected transitions. Recall@10 remains within one percentage point of Fresh in 10 cases, and query throughput exceeds DGM-Local in 14 cases. Parameter sweeps on three transitions further demonstrate favorable migration-time--recall tradeoffs beyond the default settings. Across all 240 directed transitions among 16 MS MARCO models, STARR achieves a median construction speedup of 16.71$\times$ with a median recall loss of 1.0 percentage point.

papers.title_en: Look Before You Leap: Re-Architecting Disk-Resident Vector Search with TriVS
papers.authors: Yizou Chen, Baotong Lu, Peiqi Yin, Zhisheng Hu, Qi Chen, Ming-Chang Yang
papers.evidence: 磁盘驻留近似最近邻向量检索架构
papers.tldr: 磁盘驻留向量检索虽可突破DRAM容量限制，但现有系统仍受I/O瓶颈制约。TriVS将查询重构为粗粒度接近、内存蒸馏、向量级精确收敛三阶段，解耦搜索粒度并衔接簇级与向量级I/O。在五个数据集上，Recall@10=0.9时吞吐达PipeANN的3.42倍，延迟降51.2%，磁盘I/O降63.7%。该工作以更少内存和存储实现高效磁盘向量搜索，为ANNS架构提供新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Disk-resident approximate nearest-neighbor search (ANNS) scales vector search beyond DRAM, yet state-of-the-art systems remain I/O-bound, even with fast SSDs and sophisticated I/O execution. To understand this bottleneck, we conduct an I/O-centric analysis that breaks each query down into an approach phase that locates a query-near region and a converge phase that resolves the final top-k. This analysis reveals complementary I/O tradeoffs: cluster-based search circumvents approach-phase I/O through in-memory routing but reads coarse-grained, full clusters during convergence, whereas graph-based search employs fine-grained, vector-level I/O throughout, enabling efficient convergence at the cost of inevitable I/O during the approach phase.   To combine the complementary I/O benefits of the two granularities, we present TriVS, a new paradigm that re-architects disk-resident vector search as a trilogy: approach coarsely, distill progressively, and converge exactly. Its key innovations come in two parts. First, it decouples the approach and converge phases from a single search granularity, employing cluster-based search to avoid approach-phase I/O and leveraging vector-level I/O for efficient convergence. Second, to bridge the two granularities, it introduces a new in-memory distill phase between the original two, progressively reducing routed clusters to a vector-level shortlist using compact quantized vectors before disk access. Moreover, coarser clustering shrinks the centroid-routing index, allowing TriVS to reallocate existing memory to distillation rather than expand its memory budget. Our evaluation on five datasets spanning diverse vector types and scales shows that, at Recall@10=0.9, TriVS achieves on average 3.42X PipeANN's throughput, 51.2% lower latency, and 63.7% less disk I/O, while using less memory and storage than PipeANN.

papers.title_en: LEDGER: Auditable Agent Memory Under Change
papers.authors: Md Aidul Islam, Md Nasir Uddin Shuvo, Muhammad Waseem, Pekka Abrahamsson
papers.evidence: 面向事实变更与遗忘的智能体记忆层，并在LongMemEval上评测
papers.tldr: 现有智能体记忆多在固定历史上评测且只看最终答案，忽略事实变更、来源可信度与删除请求。LEDGER 用模型提出事实、显式规则裁决当前值、可信源与删除，LEDGER+EP 增加原始对话检索并在删除时清洗。编码负载留出种子上正确率91.1%，优于全量回放83.3%；LongMemEval 与全量回放同为74.8%却仅用1%上下文。贡献是可审计、可删除且高效的记忆层。
papers.abstract_en: Agent memory systems are mostly evaluated on fixed histories, and only their final answers are scored. In real use, facts change, sources differ in reliability, and users ask the agent to forget things. We present LEDGER, a memory layer in which a language model proposes facts and explicit rules decide which value is current, which source to trust, and what to delete. Each fact keeps its source and the period in which it held. LEDGER+EP adds a search over raw conversation turns for questions the ledger does not cover, and scrubs these turns on deletion. We compare both against no memory, full-history replay, retrieval over raw transcripts, and Mem0, with the same answering model and prompt, on a synthetic multi-session coding-agent workload and a 210-question subset of LongMemEval, and we score both the evidence each memory sends to the model and the answer. On the coding workload, LEDGER+EP in fallback mode answers 94.3% of questions correctly on five development seeds and 91.1% on five held-out seeds, against 82.1% and 83.3% for full replay, the strongest baseline. When a deletion request only describes the fact, no deleted value reached our systems' evidence in any evaluated probe. On LongMemEval, LEDGER+EP in augment mode has the same observed accuracy as full replay (74.8%) with 1% of its context. The main limitation is that the coding workload is synthetic and built by us; on LongMemEval, the differences between the strongest systems are within the confidence intervals.

papers.title_en: A Capability Framework for Evaluating Agentic AI Platforms in Regulated Enterprises
papers.authors: Abbas Raza Ali, Muhammad Ajmal Siddiqui, Moona Zahid
papers.evidence: 评估智能体平台能力的框架
papers.tldr: 企业采购Agentic AI平台的速度远超对其度量能力，现有公开基准只在固定环境中评测模型，无法反映平台编排、记忆、治理等层面的差异。某全球银行创新实验室开展工业级“bakeoff”，由跨职能专家组用九个能力维度评估十个平台在三类金融业务负载上的表现。结果显示平台可分为三个稳定层级，但也发现Cronbach's alpha高达0.98的晕轮效应，说明演示式打分同时衡量了展示能力。据此提出“先门控后打分”的四层评估协议与可复现性规范。
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI platforms-systems in which LLM agents plan, invoke tools, retain memory and coordinate to change the state of enterprise systems-are being procured faster than they can be measured. Public agent benchmarks score models in fixed harnesses; enterprises buy integrated platforms whose orchestration, memory, governance and tooling layers dominate outcomes, and they buy them largely on the strength of vendor demonstrations. We report an industrial evaluation programme ("bakeoff") run by the innovation laboratory of a global bank in which ten platforms-spanning open-source frameworks, proprietary products and hyperscaler ecosystems-were assessed by a cross-functional panel on nine capability dimensions across three financial-services workloads: counterparty credit risk, retrieval-augmented generation and process automation. Scores separate the field into three tiers that are stable under alternative weightings, and surface workload-specific strengths that aggregates hide. A secondary analysis, however, finds Cronbach's alpha = 0.98 across nominally distinct dimensions and rank correlations >= 0.93 with the total for eight of nine: a halo effect indicating that demonstration-based scoring measures presentation as much as capability. From these lessons we propose a gate-then-score evaluation protocol with four layers (capability, execution reliability, governance gates, business value), trace-level reliability metrics estimated over repeated runs, an autonomy-readiness scale and a reproducibility protocol. We state precisely what the present evidence supports, and what a controlled harness must add to turn enterprise platform evaluation from structured judgement into measurement.

papers.title_en: Engram: Multi-Stage Memory for Agentic Tuning of Heterogeneous Models
papers.authors: Huanran Li, Nhat X. T. Le, Kevin De Angeli, Yao Xuan, Alireza Vahdatpour, Djordje Gligorijevic
papers.evidence: 面向大模型智能体的跨会话记忆系统与会话检索
papers.tldr: LLM智能体虽能调优神经网络，但缺少跨会话记忆，会在异构生产模型上反复试错。Engram将历史试验结果与其假设和理由关联，并判断证据是否适用于当前模型。它由在线智能体在初始指导、会话检索和候选试验审查三个决策点按需调用记忆，离线智能体则蒸馏已验证经验。在两个广告模型上，Engram以少47%的试验达到无记忆对照32次试验的效果，且最终模型平均更优。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents can now tune neural networks, yet without cross-session memory they spend costly trials rediscovering known lessons. Reuse is difficult because production models differ in architecture, training setup and inference budget. We present Engram, a memory system that links past trial outcomes with the hypotheses and rationale behind them and assesses whether this evidence applies to the current model. An online agent curates evidence at the decision points where it is needed: Initial Guidance supplies validated lessons at the start, Session Retrieval supplies related past sessions before each batch of hypotheses is generated, and Trial Candidate Review checks each trial candidate against matching past trials. Between sessions, an offline agent distills validated lessons, making the memory self-improving. On two ads models, Engram reaches the 32-trial result of a no-memory control with 47% fewer trials and also ends with a better model on average.

papers.title_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation in the Agentic Era: Tradition, Present, and Prospect
papers.authors: Chenming Tang, Haolin Li, Yiran Li, Zixian Yang, Lizhu Zhai, Rui Sun, Qizhou Huang, Yunfang Wu
papers.evidence: 系统梳理检索增强生成，涵盖索引与检索阶段
papers.tldr: RAG将冻结语言模型与外部可更新知识结合，使生成基于检索证据而非仅参数记忆。该综述沿单一生命周期轴串联离线索引、预检索、检索、后检索与编排，将索引和编排列为一等组件，并把智能体工作流视为独立范式。它系统覆盖评估、应用与开放问题，补充近期智能体时代进展。整体为RAG从传统到未来提供系统综述框架。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) couples frozen language models with external, updatable knowledge, so that generation is grounded in retrieved evidence rather than in parametric memory alone. This work maps RAG in the agentic era by joining them on a single lifecycle axis, from offline indexing through pre-retrieval, retrieval, post-retrieval, and orchestration over these stages. It treats indexing and orchestration as first-class components and agentic workflows as a paradigm of their own, and it covers the agentic work that has appeared since those reviews. Beyond these components, it covers evaluation, applications, and the questions that remain open for future exploration. From tradition to present and beyond, this work systematically reviews RAG from a perspective of the agentic era.

papers.title_en: Composing Independently Distilled Memory and Retrieval Policies for Long-Term Agents
papers.authors: Grigorii Davydenko, Artem Sakhno, Igor Pavlov, Julia Belikova, Andrey Savchenko, Maksim Makarenko
papers.evidence: 为长期智能体蒸馏记忆写入与检索策略，并在LongMemEval上评测
papers.tldr: 长期Web助手需要记忆与检索历史交互，但独立训练专家能否有效组合尚不明确。本文通过策略蒸馏，将记忆写入与顺序检索分别蒸馏到3B模型，再与固定答案生成器组合且不做联合训练。在LongMemEval上达73.1%，显著高于现有RL专家组合的36.2%，PersonaMem-v2亦更优。消融表明收益依赖跨专家兼容性，验证了独立专家蒸馏对模块化多智能体系统的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Long-lived Web assistants require effective memory and retrieval mechanisms to access information from past user interactions. While these capabilities can be learned through specialized policies, it remains unclear whether specialists trained independently in different environments can be effectively composed without joint optimization. This paper investigates compositional transfer through policy distillation. Memory-writing and sequential retrieval policies are independently distilled from frontier-model action trajectories into 3B models and combined with a fixed answer generator without downstream training. On a LongMemEval-based benchmark, the distilled composition achieves 73.1% accuracy, compared with 36.2% for a composition of existing RL-trained specialists, and also outperforms the evaluated RL-trained compositions on PersonaMem-v2. Component ablations reveal that improvements in individual policies depend on their composition, highlighting the importance of cross-specialist compatibility. Further task-specific adaptation improves accuracy to 75.2% on LongMemEval through RL and 48.9% on PersonaMem-v2 through supervised distillation. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of independent specialist distillation for modular multi-agent systems. Source code and datasets of teacher-generated memory-editing and retrieval trajectories are released to facilitate reproducibility and further research.

papers.title_en: Lost in the Hallway: Benchmarking Persistent Spatial Memory Across Revisits
papers.authors: Henry Zheng, Weibo Gong, Yang Yue, Rui Huang, Yang Zhang, Gao Huang
papers.evidence: 提出评估具身智能体持久空间记忆的ReSpaceBench基准
papers.tldr: 具身智能体需在重复到访中保持空间记忆，但现有评测常把跨次到访的物理地点身份隐含化。作者提出 ReSpaceBench，含590个场景、3244道题、9类任务，覆盖房间关联、持久状态跟踪与下游推理。评测32个模型和3个智能体视频框架，最佳零样本模型总体仅50.5%，人类为90.1%，智能体框架无整体提升。还发布无重叠训练集RS-30K，微调Qwen3-VL-8B将准确率从35.5%升至60.4%。
papers.abstract_en: Persistent spatial understanding is essential for embodied agents to operate reliably in environments they repeatedly encounter. It requires recognizing revisited places despite viewpoint changes, distinguishing them from similar-looking rooms, and updating memories as environments change. Yet existing evaluations often leave physical place identity across separated visits implicit. We introduce ReSpaceBench, a benchmark comprising 3,244 questions across 590 synthetic and real-home scenes, organized into 9 tasks spanning room association, persistent state tracking, and downstream reasoning. Controlled walkthroughs define visits by physical room entry and deliberately include same-type room distractors and cross-session object changes. Our evaluation of 32 models and 3 agentic video-understanding frameworks reveals substantial limitations: the strongest evaluated zero-shot model achieves 50.5% overall accuracy and 52.2% on a 450-question subset, compared with 90.1% for human annotators. The evaluated agentic frameworks offer no overall improvement over direct inference with the same base model. Analysis of agent execution traces reveals evidence omissions and incorrect cross-visit room associations as major failure modes, suggesting that iterative evidence seeking alone does not ensure consistent spatial memory. Further analyses expose a gap between recognizing familiar rooms and identifying the correct visited room, while annotation-guided sampling highlights the importance of preserving intervening visits and transitions. We also provide RS-30K, a separate training dataset from synthetic sources with no template, scene, route, or video overlap with the benchmark. Fine-tuning Qwen3-VL-8B raises overall accuracy from 35.5% to 60.4%, with the largest gains in association and improvements extending to real-life scenes.

papers.title_en: SciResearch-Eval: Evaluating Scientific Judgment in Autonomous Experimental Agents
papers.authors: Brian T. Weston, Alondra Torres Contreras, Aldair E. Gongora
papers.evidence: 评估自主实验智能体的交互式基准
papers.tldr: 科学实验智能体能否在模拟器缺失物理规律时仍做出可靠判断，此前缺乏结合智能体自主设计实验、缺陷模拟器与校准区间评分的基准。作者提出 SciResearch-Eval，让智能体通过加热材料、拟合热传导模拟器来测量热物性，并给出95%区间。在93个任务、9个模型、2511个回合上，多数模型在模拟器缺物理时仍自信报错值，区间覆盖率仅20-62%，而 GPT-6 Astra 达94%、Claude Fable 5.2 达99%。该基准首次把实验设计、故意缺陷模拟器与精确真值下的区间校准评分结合，并开源环境与评分器。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce SciResearch-Eval, an interactive benchmark of scientific judgment built on a standard laboratory problem: measuring a material's thermal properties by heating it and fitting a heat-conduction simulator. An agent designs its own experiments, uses a supplied simulator that may be under-resolved or physically wrong, and reports each property with a 95% interval. To our knowledge it is the first benchmark to combine agent-designed experiments, a deliberately flawed simulator, and proper scoring of calibrated intervals against exact ground truth. On a held-out split (93 tasks, 9 models, 2,511 episodes), models handle procedural traps. When the simulator is missing physics, most report wrong values while stating they are 95% sure: their ranges contain the truth in 20-62% of cases, against 94% for GPT-6 Astra and 99% for Claude Fable 5.2. At default effort the failing Claude 5.5 models rarely diagnose the missing physics (Opus in 35% of episodes, against 66% for Astra), and even when they do, their ranges often miss; Astra and Fable design experiments in which the flawed simulator is accurate, such as gentle heating, which keeps Astra calibrated even when it does not name the cause. Asking for wider intervals does not help; stating the strategy improves interval scores 1.6-2.5-fold, replicated on a pre-registered fresh split, but coverage barely moves. A pre-registered effort ablation shows that the correction is latent in the Claude 5.5 models: at maximum effort Opus improves more than tenfold and is no longer detectably behind Astra at default, but only with 13-31 times more reasoning; older and open-weight models gain nothing. Fable 5.2 is the most accurate model at default effort (interval score 1.9 times better than Astra's) but writes 6 times as many tokens, and at Astra's token count it falls short. We release the environment, graders and harness.

papers.title_en: The abc index: Exact Retrieval for Learned Sparse Representations
papers.authors: Rossano Venturini
papers.evidence: 与HNSW和Qdrant对比的精确实时稀疏检索索引
papers.tldr: 学习型稀疏检索（LSR）查询项多且带权重，经典动态剪枝被认为失效，近似索引常被默认更快。abc 仅用标准 IR 技术构建精确索引：TAAT、Block-Max MaxScore、二进制打包与 doc-id 重排，并针对现代 CPU 优化。在 MS MARCO 四个 LSR 模型上，它比 Qdrant/Lucene 精确检索快 6.5-84x/13-55x，比 BMP 快 2.9-18x 且索引小 5-7x；对近似索引更省空间，k 增大时延迟增长更慢。其贡献是证明精确 LSR 检索可兼顾速度、空间与免调参。
papers.abstract_en: In learned sparse retrieval (LSR), queries have tens of terms with learned weights, on which classic dynamic pruning is believed to fail, and approximate indexes such as Seismic and HNSW are considered faster than exact ones. We challenge this view with abc, an exact index built only from standard IR techniques: term-at-a-time (TAAT) evaluation, Block-Max MaxScore, binary packing and doc-id reordering. They are combined in a new design and engineered for modern CPUs. On MS MARCO encoded with four LSR models, the abc index is the fastest exact index at every k: 6.5-84x faster than the exact search of Qdrant, 13-55x faster than that of Lucene, and 2.9-18x faster than BMP with an index 5-7x smaller. Against approximate indexes, it takes 1.5-3.6x less space, and its latency grows much more slowly with k: they are up to 4.3x faster at k=10, but at k=1000 it overtakes them, by up to 7.4x. Exactness comes with an extra benefit: there are no parameters to tune.

papers.title_en: Agent Money Benchmark: Can AI Agents Be Trusted to Spend Money?
papers.authors: Zhe Chen, Emma Hsieh, Vicky Fu
papers.evidence: 提出评估自主智能体花钱行为的基准
papers.tldr: 给AI代理钱包后，可信度取决于它如何花钱及取得什么结果。作者提出Agent Money Benchmark（AMB），用80项模拟卖家支付任务和76项实时数据研究问题，将报价、支付与最终答案关联，评估12个模型。支付经Solana主网USDC和x402结算；仅3个模型在80项支付任务中通过79项且无支付或预算错误，9个曾落入一次卖家陷阱。按数据与推理成本估算，等分赛道时每100美元浪费从21.0到70.8美元，为代理支付安全建立基准。
papers.abstract_en: Giving an AI agent a wallet lets it buy data and services on a client's behalf. Trust then depends on how it spends money and what that spending achieves. We introduce Agent Money Benchmark (AMB) to test whether agents spend a client's money well, starting with purchases of information for financial decisions. We link seller quotes and payments to final answers, evaluating 12 models on 80 payment tasks with simulated sellers and 76 research questions using live data. Purchases settled in USDC on Solana mainnet via x402, a protocol for paying per web request. Three of the 12 models passed 79 of 80 payment tasks without payment or budget errors. Nine fell for a seller's trap at least once; repeat charges and above-list quotes accounted for 79% of scam events. We estimate waste from data and inference costs, counting failed payment tasks in full and research answers in proportion to missed points. With spending split equally between tracks, estimated waste ranged from \$21.0 per \$100 for Claude Fable 5.2 to \$70.8 for GPT-6 Luna.

papers.title_en: The Evaluation Substrate Matters: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Serving Substrates
papers.authors: Haoyuan Zheng, Dongting Li, Hancheng Ye, Qinsi Wang, Mingyuan Ma, Yuncheng Yao, Yifei Wang, Baijun Zhou, Zishan Shao, Tingjun Chen, Hai Helen Li, Danyang Zhuo, Yiran Chen
papers.evidence: 评测多智能体系统对服务底座的依赖
papers.tldr: 多智能体评测常忽略服务底座，同一工作流换环境后性能排名可能反转。论文提出 MASSys，在多种服务底座与负载下用五类任务测量质量、时延、成本与失败证据。受控诊断中，Star 在 KV-cache 压力下平均时延排名从第一跌至第四，Chain 反向升至第一，负载升高还带来长尾与超时。研究主张在明确运行条件下评测 MAS，并同时报告交付、质量与执行失效点。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) usually coordinate heterogeneous models and tools to solve complex tasks, creating a growing need for reliable evaluation. However, a multi-agent workflow that is fastest in one serving environment can lose its advantage in another, even when its models, prompts, and task remain fixed. This makes a benchmark result conditional on how the workflow is executed. We introduce MASSys, a benchmark for measuring this dependence in multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems. MASSys executes the same candidate-task pairs across serving substrates and load regimes, using five workload families spanning software repair, research synthesis, financial analysis, interactive control, and diagram generation. It records task quality alongside delivery, latency, cost, resource pressure, and failure evidence. In a controlled motivation diagnostic, the Star workflow falls from first to fourth in mean-latency rank under KV-cache pressure, while Chain rises from fourth to first. The substrate sweeps further show that increasing load creates long runtime tails and timeout pressure. In several task families, quality among evaluated outputs changes less than effective quality over submitted jobs: the system delivers fewer usable results even when the surviving outputs remain competitive. Tool and runtime traces reveal that these outcomes involve both model serving and non-model execution. Together, the results motivate evaluating MAS designs over explicit operating conditions and reporting which tasks are delivered, how well they are solved, and where execution breaks down.

papers.title_en: S$^2$LMR: Supervised Sequential Long-Context Multi-Step Retriever
papers.authors: Qiang Hu, Kaiyi Ji
papers.evidence: 面向长上下文RAG的监督式序列检索器
papers.tldr: 长上下文多步检索是检索增强生成的重要能力，但现有强方法训练成本高、流程复杂，监督式检索器虽简单廉价却明显落后。本文指出差距源于训练与推理的三处错配：训练负例过易、检索前缀含噪、打分与位置无关。据此提出S²LMR，用单一共享Transformer编码显式文本状态的演化来完成多步检索。在4K至10M token的长上下文推理、多跳QA与大海捞针基准上，性能可比SOTA，且单张A6000约2小时即可训练至10M上下文。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-step retrieval over long contexts is a key capability for retrieval-augmented generation, but strong existing approaches are costly and complex to train. Supervised retrievers are far simpler and cheaper, yet they fall well behind in this setting. We show that this gap stems not from supervised training itself, but from three misalignments between training and inference: easy training negatives, noisy retrieval prefixes, and position-agnostic scoring. Guided by this analysis, we introduce S$^2$LMR, a simple yet effective supervised sequential retriever that models multi-step retrieval as the evolution of an explicit textual state encoded by a single shared Transformer. On long-context reasoning, multi-hop QA, and needle-in-a-haystack benchmarks with context lengths ranging from 4K to 10M tokens, S$^2$LMR achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art methods, substantially outperforming prior supervised retrievers. Notably, it requires only $\sim$2 hours of training on a single A6000 for contexts of up to 10M tokens, while remaining robust across a wide range of hyperparameter settings.

papers.title_en: SuperNav-1.5: Structured Spatial Memory For Agentic Navigation Systems
papers.authors: Jiarui Guo, Jinkai Zhang, Yuanhong Yu, Yongchen Zai, Futang Zhu, Ruizhen Hu, Sida Peng, Xiaowei Zhou
papers.evidence: 由导航智能体自行构建与维护的结构化空间记忆
papers.tldr: 针对跨会话与连续目标导航中的场景级记忆设计难题，现有场景图推理开销大、图文记录难转成可执行几何路径。SuperNav-1.5 让智能体构建结构化空间记忆：区域分割占据地图叠加地图锚定记忆节点，并支持未访问区域引导与已知位置路径规划。多会话下提出智能体引导重定位，用区域先验约束几何匹配。实验在单/多目标与需求驱动基准上领先，路径效率提升显著，记忆可复用并实机验证。
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses the challenge of scene-level memory design for efficient navigation across sessions and successive object goals. Recent methods commonly represent a scene using scene graphs or image--text records. However, dense scene-graph representations impose substantial reasoning and context overhead on multimodal large language models, while image--text records cannot be directly converted into executable geometric routes. To address these limitations, we propose SuperNav-1.5, an agentic navigation system equipped with a structured spatial memory constructed by the agent. The memory consists of an area-segmented occupancy map annotated with agent-maintained, map-grounded memory nodes. This map guides the agent toward unvisited areas and provides executable routes to known locations. For multi-session navigation, we introduce agent-guided relocalization, whereby the agent infers an area prior from current observations and stored memory records to constrain geometric matching and localize the robot within the stored map. Together, these designs enable efficient navigation across session and successive object goals. Experiments show that our method outperforms baselines on single-object, multi-object, and demand-driven navigation benchmarks, with particularly strong gains in path efficiency. Multi-session evaluation demonstrates that the constructed memory can be reused, while deployment on a real quadruped robot further shows the system's applicability.

papers.title_en: When the Bill Falls: Reusing the Old Index Defers,Never Avoids, Re-encoding in Complete Embedding-Model Migration
papers.authors: Nannan Zhao, Jiameng Zhang, Taoyu Zhong, Hao Wang, Bo Wang
papers.evidence: 向量索引的嵌入模型迁移与重新编码
papers.tldr: 向量索引更换嵌入模型通常需重编码全库，近期方案试图用适配器或窗口重排复用旧索引。论文在十六组模型对、段落与代码语料及 NQ 上做预注册回放，系统评估复用是否真能省去重编码。结果显示复用只会推迟而非避免重编码；仅同族 LLM 桥接适配器略胜旧模型；窗口重排成本可由旧索引预估，深度规则误差低于百万分之四。作者据此给出迁移前三条决策规则。
papers.abstract_en: Upgrading the embedding model behind a vector index requires re-encoding the corpus. Recent work reuses the old index through adapters or window re-ranking. Across sixteen model pairs on passage and code corpora, plus eleven on Natural Questions (NQ), we find three results. First, reuse never avoids re-encoding: if migration must complete, every strategy eventually encodes every document; reuse only changes when that work is paid and the quality served meanwhile. Second, adapters should be compared with the old model, not only the new one. Of five adapter variants, only same-family LLM bridges beat the old model, and only by a negligible margin. Third, window re-ranking cost can be priced from the old index alone; pre-registered replays on all 8,841,823 passages confirmed the prediction on all three tested pairs. Workload skew also matters: across 36 further pre-registered Zipf replays, the planned family matched on 32. These findings yield three pre-migration rules: whether reuse is worthwhile, which strategy to use, and how deep a window to take. The depth rule priced every window that reached target quality to within 4 parts in 10^5 of the corpus. On NQ, a pre-committed plan selected the family on 10 of 11 pairs and priced every window exactly. Quality inputs transferred less reliably across corpus scale, so the model gap and window quality loss must be measured on the serving index.

papers.title_en: MemMend: A Selective Revision Framework for Memory Question Answering
papers.authors: Sheng Shi, Geng Li
papers.evidence: 面向长期记忆问答的选择性修订框架
papers.tldr: 长时记忆问答若逐条修订答案，推理开销大且可能破坏已正确事实。MemMend采用模块化选择性修订，将可能不完整的答案路由给编辑器，用有界精确文本替换表示修改，并仅接受源坐标可解析且编辑操作合法的修正。在LoCoMo开发集上取得67.17对话宏F1和88.35平均Judge分数，同时减少62.37%修订调用。该工作表明选择性编辑可作为可复用的质量—成本操作点。
papers.abstract_en: Revising every answer from a long-term memory can consume substantial inference budget and damage facts that were already correct. We introduce MemMend, a modular selective revision framework that routes potentially incomplete answers to an editor, represents corrections as bounded exact-text replacements, and accepts only edits with resolvable source coordinates and valid edit operations. The editor preserves the current answer when no legal repair is proposed; accepted edits require no additional semantic-verification call. On 1,986 LoCoMo development questions, MemMend achieves 67.17 conversation-macro F1 and 88.35 mean Judge score, improving over a verified revision chain by 0.82 and 1.24 points while using 62.37% fewer revision calls. Routing uses 54.15% fewer revision calls than ungated local review, with similar F1 but a 0.67-point lower Judge score. Applied directly to native PropMem, Mem0, and SimpleMem answers, the editing interface raises F1 by 3.79, 6.44, and 0.42 points. It outperforms same-gate rewriting and saves 49.85-83.72% of editing calls relative to ungated editing, which retains higher F1 in this adaptation. A source-by-editing factorial supports local editing for F1 but leaves an independent quality benefit from source obligations unresolved. Transfer to 451 LongMemEval-V2 Small questions also favors revision efficiency, while an external PerLTQA dialogue subset reveals a completeness gap. These results support selective editing as a reusable quality-cost operating point.

papers.title_en: When Visually Rich Documents Meet Multi-Vector Retrieval for Region-level Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Xu Yuan, Liangbo Ning, Yujuan Ding, Qing Li, Wenqi Fan
papers.evidence: 面向视觉丰富文档RAG的区域级多向量检索
papers.tldr: 视觉丰富文档蕴含文本、视觉与版面信息，但Text-RAG难以充分利用，早期Vision-RAG又常用粗粒度表示和整页视觉上下文，易遮蔽局部证据并造成冗余。作者提出区域级框架MV-VisRAG，先以内容自适应区域化构建语义完整区域，再用VLM检索器编码局部区域向量与页面全局向量。该方法经多模态重构预训练和检索微调，执行后交互检索并按匹配分数筛选区域，重排为紧凑视觉上下文供生成；五个基准上检索与生成均优于基线，且显著降低视觉token与计算开销。
papers.abstract_en: Visually rich documents (VRDs) convey knowledge through textual, visual, and layout information that text-centric Retrieval-Augmented Generation (Text-RAG) struggles to fully exploit. Recent Vision-RAG approaches enable retrieval and generation directly from document images, retaining this multimodal information. However, earlier Vision-RAG methods commonly adopt coarse retrieval representations and full-page visual contexts, which can obscure local evidence and introduce substantial redundancy and computational overhead. To address these challenges, we propose MV-VisRAG, a region-level Vision-RAG framework that uses semantically complete regions for both document representation and visual augmentation. Specifically, MV-VisRAG first constructs these regions through a ContentAdaptive Regionalization module. It then encodes them into local region vectors and a page-level global vector using a VLM-based retriever trained through multimodal reconstruction pretraining and retrieval fine-tuning. With this compact multi-vector representation, MV-VisRAG performs late-interaction retrieval and estimates region contributions from the resulting matching scores. These contributions guide the selection of relevant regions, which are then rearranged into a compact visual context for generation. Experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate retrieval and generation gains over corresponding baselines, while region-level augmentation substantially reduces visual tokens and computational cost. Our code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/xandery-geek/MV-VisRAG.

papers.title_en: EvoViM: Recursively Self-Evolving Visual Agents for Exploration with Deferred Queries
papers.authors: Xinyu Cao, Tianjie Ju, Zhuosheng Zhang
papers.evidence: 由交互经验与视觉轨迹构建的智能体记忆
papers.tldr: 多模态智能体在“探索后才给出查询”的场景中难以保留视觉证据。EvoViM让冻结MLLM把交互经验递归写成一份视觉程序，用程序保存图像并直接在像素上计算，且由同一模型追踪失败、修正操作与笔记工具。六个任务上较AutoMem提升31.3-47.6分，说明交互经验对证据保留与使用很关键。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language model (MLLM) agents have shown promising capabilities in task-oriented environments. However, they still struggle when queries are deferred until after exploration, requiring them to retain visual evidence before knowing which details will matter. We introduce EvoViM, a recursively self-evolving framework in which a frozen multimodal model turns its own interaction experience into one visual program for memory and skills. The program retains images and computes directly on pixels, and its operations decide how this evidence is used in each task. During memory evolution, the same model traces failures in its visual trajectories to the operations that lost or misused evidence and revises them. It also rewrites the notes and analysis tools that guide later revisions, which then build on earlier findings and skip changes that have already failed. We evaluate EvoViM with three multimodal models on six tasks covering visual matching, spatial recall, and sequential decision-making, including three tasks with deferred queries. Across the six tasks, EvoViM improves the average score over AutoMem, the strongest baseline in the main comparison, by 31.3-47.6 points on held-out episodes. Programs written once from the initial environment instructions perform substantially worse, highlighting the value of interaction experience in shaping how visual evidence is retained and used. Code and dataset are available at https://evovim.github.io/.

papers.title_en: VistaTree: Question Answering over Long Multimodal Documents with Image-Derived Summary Trees
papers.authors: Yexiang Cheng, Xiaochen Zheng, David Tokar, Tatyana Y. Doktorova
papers.evidence: 面向长文档问答的选择性检索与分层导航
papers.tldr: 长多模态文档问答需跨页定位文本、表格和图像证据，超出上下文窗口时须选择性检索。VistaTree 直接基于渲染页面图像构建摘要树：将文档切为连续页段，递归聚成主题层级，并精炼同级摘要以区分相邻章节。查询时用节点摘要选相关节点并读取对应页面，在完整目录超预算时进行层级导航。在 MMLongBench-Doc 与 LongDocURL 上，用本地视觉语言模型评测答案质量与检索成本，并量化全局与层级索引访问的性能差距。
papers.abstract_en: Answering questions over long multimodal documents requires locating relevant evidence across pages containing text, tables, and figures. When the document exceeds the model's context window, selective retrieval becomes necessary. We introduce VistaTree, a document question-answering agent that builds a summary tree directly from rendered page images. VistaTree segments documents into contiguous page spans, recursively groups them into a topic hierarchy, and refines sibling summaries to distinguish neighboring sections. At query time, the agent uses node summaries to select relevant nodes and reads the corresponding pages, using hierarchical navigation when the full outline exceeds the context budget. Experiments on MMLongBench-Doc and LongDocURL evaluate answer quality and retrieval cost using a locally hosted vision-language model, and quantify the performance gap between global and hierarchical access to the index.

papers.title_en: FORGETMENOT: Auditing Memory Driven Privacy Risks in Commercial AI Agents
papers.authors: Ismat Jarin, Tu Le, Athina Markopoulou
papers.evidence: 审计商业AI智能体长期记忆的隐私风险
papers.tldr: 商业AI智能体长期记忆带来隐私与合规风险，但存储、披露、透明度和删除控制缺乏审计。本文提出FORGETMENOT框架，采集五款主流智能体约3800段多轮会话、约600万token进行分析。结果显示智能体存储大量敏感属性，可见记忆仅约20%，隐身记忆注入使Copilot和Claude存储量分别增25%和15%，删除后仍泄漏，Gemini第三方邮件泄漏率31.9%。
papers.abstract_en: Commercial AI agents increasingly incorporate long-term memory (both persistent and chat-history) to enable more accurate and personalized responses, raises significant privacy and policy concerns. Yet little is known about user privacy risks associated with memory behavior, in particular, about memory storage, disclosure, transparency and deletion control. To bridge this gap, we propose FORGETMENOT, an auditing framework for analyzing the privacy risks of long term memory in commercial AI agents. Using our framework, we collect around 3800 multi-turn sessions comprising around 6M tokens across five popular AI agents. Our results show that agents store a wide range of personal attributes, including demographics, health, and sensitive details. Furthermore, user visible memory reveals substantially less (around 20% on average) attributes than the agents store in practice, exposing a significant transparency gap. Our stealth memory injection (SMI) technique further increases the amount of personal and sensitive attribute stored in memory, raising it by 25% and 15% for Copilot and Claude, respectively. We further observed memory deletion control is unreliable, as all five agents exhibit non-zero post deletion leakage, including health and self-harm related attributes. Finally, we demonstrate the feasibility of memory disclosure to a 3rd-party email recipient as a proof-of-concept, as Gemini shows 31.9% leakage rate. Together, our findings reveal notable privacy risks in commercial agents memory. Finally, we discuss both design implications and regulatory recommendations to protect users memory privacy in commercial agents.

papers.title_en: AgentBouncer: Defending Software Engineering Agents via Dynamic System-Call Mediation
papers.authors: Pascal Joos, Michael Pradel
papers.evidence: 通过分析智能体执行轨迹检测恶意行为
papers.tldr: 软件工程智能体借工具访问文件、执行命令和下载资源，却易受提示注入、恶意工具或供应链攻击；现有轨迹分析只看提示与工具调用，难发现实际环境动作。AgentBouncer 在运行时中介系统调用，用 LLM 仲裁器按必要性与安全性判定并拒绝不安全调用，预置策略和层级缓存降低开销。在 340 个攻击与 SWE-bench Verified 良性任务上，攻击成功率从 99.41% 降至 10.59%，良性工具调用失败仅 0.25%。每任务仅增 47 秒和 0.0036 美元，为 SE 智能体提供可部署的运行时防护。
papers.abstract_en: Software engineering (SE) agents can complete diverse engineering tasks by interacting with the development environment via tools that access files, run commands, and download resources. Unfortunately, the same ability that makes SE agents useful also makes them prone to performing unintended malicious actions through prompt injections, malicious tools, or supply-chain attacks. Existing defenses that analyze the agent trajectory may fail to detect such attacks, as they inspect only the initial prompt and the sequence of tool calls, but not the actual actions that are executed in the environment. This paper presents AgentBouncer, a novel runtime enforcement system that prevents SE agents from performing malicious actions by mediating, and if necessary denying, system calls that agents trigger via tool calls. The core of AgentBouncer is an LLM arbiter that judges system calls along two axes, necessity and safety for the current task. It denies unsafe system calls, and the less necessary a system call appears, the more certain the arbiter has to be about its safety to allow it. To manage runtime overhead, preseeded policy rules and hierarchy-aware caching ensure that the LLM arbiter is only invoked for key decisions. We evaluate AgentBouncer on a dataset of 340 attacks on the development environment, covering four attack vectors, combined with benign issue resolution tasks from SWE-bench Verified. AgentBouncer reduces the attack success rate from 99.41% for an unsupervised agent to 10.59%, which is 18.23-73.53 percentage points lower than competitive state-of-the-art defenses. At the same time, AgentBouncer preserves the task success rate of the agent, with only 0.25% failed benign tool calls. Per benign task, AgentBouncer adds 47 seconds and USD 0.0036 in LLM costs to an unsupervised agent, whereas the closest existing runtime defense adds 4.5x as much time and 9.6x as much cost.
